newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian housing groups say industry soft.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian housing groups say industry soft.

text.p: The Australian housing industry said on Wednesday seasonally-adjusted November housing finance figures showed demand for housing remained soft, although the trend showed signs of some improvement.
The Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday the number of dwellings financed in November seasonally-adjusted fell 2.9 percent by volume to 38,460 dwellings from a revised 39,592 in October.
In trend terms, the number of dwellings financed rose 0.1 percent by volume to 40,194 dwellings in November from 40,158 the previous month, the Bureau said.
Master Builders Australia said the seasonally adjusted figures were adding to fears that the housing recovery was faltering.

"Home buyers confidence, particularly among first home buyers, remains fragile and is holding back the rate of recovery," Master Builders National Director, Economics and Housing, Wilhelm Harnisch said in a statement.

The Real Estate Institute of Australia said in a statement the rise in the trend pointed to an overall improvement in the housing market, with a solid upturn expected within the first half of 1997. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730
